title: Base Launch Run
description:
Base Launch Run — complete the tasks and share a 0.0004 ETH pool on Base.

PeddleQuest Labs is the PeddleQuest team testing its own platform end to end. This run's reward is a real 0.0004 ETH pool, funded into the PeddlesQuestEscrow contract on Base (0x16267bE6D067b3d411bf779B5aD041f9eba4CadE) rather than held by us. The top 4 on the board each get 0.0001 ETH, paid by the contract after the quest ends and the winners are published on chain.

The quest page shows the pool as escrowed only once the chain confirms the deposit. The contracts are unaudited.
